about: Phase 1b by-eye check (pre-registered): the 50 unsupported e4b_sft mentions sampled by object_precision.py in results/a0_e4b_sft_vs_e4b_hf/spot_check_e4b_sft.csv (sample chosen before looking), each judged on the 8 describer frames of its window at 160x120.
